name: Darjeeling Toy Train
kids_hook: Chalo aaj Darjeeling ghoomte hain! Ye dekho Darjeeling ki Toy Train! Kya aap aisi chhook-chhook train me baithe ho?
voice_speech: Arrey waah champ! Chalo aaj Darjeeling ghoomte hain! Ye dekho Darjeeling ki pyari Toy Train! Ye pahadon ke beech chhook-chhook karke chalti hai!
kids_facts: Yeh train 140 saal purani hai aur isko World Heritage Wonder mana jata hai!
Train pahad par gol-gol ghoomti hai jise Batasia Loop kehte hain!
Yahan se barf se dhaki Kanchenjunga pahadiyan dikhti hain!
curiosity_question: Kya aapko pata hai toy train bina phisle pahad par kaise chadhti hai?

name: Ooty Nilgiri Mountain Train
kids_hook: Nilgiri pahadon ki Ooty Toy Train me chadhne chalein? Yahan chocolate factory bhi hai!
voice_speech: Yaaay! Chalo Ooty chalte hain! Nilgiri pahadon me neeli toy train aur yummy handmade chocolates!
kids_facts: Yeh train Asia ki sabse steep dhalan par chalti hai!
Raste me 16 tunnels aur 250 se zyada pul aate hain!
Ooty me bache homemade chocolates aur boat ride bohot enjoy karte hain!
curiosity_question: Pahadon me toy train ke neeche special teeth (gears) kyun hote hain?

name: Shimla Kalka Heritage Railway
kids_hook: Shimla ki barfili wadiyon me 103 tunnels wali toy train dekho!
voice_speech: Wah champ! Shimla chalo! Yahan toy train 103 gufao yani tunnels se gujarti hai!
kids_facts: Barog tunnel is raste ki sabse lambi tunnel hai jo 1 kilometer lambi hai!
Winter me train ke aage barf hatane wala special plough lagta hai!
curiosity_question: Tunnel ke andar train horn kyun bajati hai?

name: Gulmarg Gondola & Snow Peaks
kids_hook: Duniya ki sabse unchi cable car me baith kar barf ke gole fekne chalna hai?
voice_speech: Woohoo! Chalo Kashmir ke Gulmarg me! Cable car me hawa me udo aur baraf ka snowman banao!
kids_facts: Yeh duniya ki second sabse unchi cable car hai jo 14,000 feet par le jati hai!
Yahan bache snow sledging aur snow scooter ride karte hain!
curiosity_question: Snowman banane ke liye baraf ko kaise roll karte hain?

name: Manali & Rohtang Pass
kids_hook: Manali me fluffy Yak par baitho aur snow scooter chalao!
voice_speech: Arrey wah! Manali me barf ki chadar bichi hai! Chalo Yak par baith kar photo khinchwayein!
kids_facts: Yak ke lambe baal hote hain jo use thandi se bachate hain!
Atal Tunnel se nikalte hi achanak chaaron taraf baraf hi baraf dikhti hai!
curiosity_question: Pahadi bhaloo aur Yak thand me kaise garam rehte hain?

name: Nainital Mango Lake & Ropeway
kids_hook: Aam (Mango) jaisi shape wali lake me boat chalayein aur ropeway se pahad dekhein!
voice_speech: Chalo Nainital! Naini jheel me colourful swan boat chalayein aur pahadi par ropeway se jayein!
kids_facts: Nainital jheel upar se bilkul ek meethhe Aam jaisi shape me dikhti hai!
Yahan Mall Road par colorful candles milti hain!
curiosity_question: Boat paani ke upar float kaise karti hai?

name: Ladakh Pangong Lake & Magnetic Hill
kids_hook: Jaadui pahad jahan gaadi bina chalu kiye apne aap upar chadhne lagti hai!
voice_speech: Dekhiye Ladakh ka jadoo! Magnetic hill par gaadi apne aap chalti hai aur Pangong lake ka paani rang badalta hai!
kids_facts: Pangong Lake ka paani neela, hara aur laal rang badalta rehta hai!
Yahan do-kubad (double hump) wale camel milte hain!
curiosity_question: Double hump wale camel regular camel se alag kaise hote hain?

name: Mussoorie Kempty Falls
kids_hook: Pahad se girte jharne me chham-chham nahao aur cable car me jhoolo!
voice_speech: Pahadon ki rani Mussoorie me Kempty falls ka thanda jharana aur fun water splash!
kids_facts: Yeh jharna 40 feet unchai se girta hai aur cable car se seedha jharne tak jate hain!
curiosity_question: Jharna pahad ke upar se kahan se aata hai?

name: National Zoological Park (Delhi Zoo)
kids_hook: White Tiger aur giant Hippopotamus dekhne Delhi Zoo chalein!
voice_speech: Arrey wah! Delhi Zoo chalo! Dekho safed sher kitna shandar roar karta hai!
kids_facts: White tiger ka colour ek rare genetic magic ki wajah se white aur black stripes wala hota hai!
Zoo me bache battery wali open safari car me ghoomte hain!
curiosity_question: Sher din me kitne ghante sota hai?

name: Mysore Zoo & Giraffe Enclave
kids_hook: Lambi gardan wale Giraffe ko apne haath se grass khilayein!
voice_speech: Dekhiye Mysore Zoo! Yahan Giraffe itna lamba hai ki second floor tak pahuche!
kids_facts: Giraffe ki jeebh 45 cm lambi aur dark purple hoti hai taaki sooraj se dhoop na lage!
Mysore Zoo India ke sabse purane aur cleanest zoos me se ek hai!
curiosity_question: Giraffe soye bina khade-khade kaise rehta hai?

name: Kaziranga National Park
kids_hook: Ek seeng wala giant Rhinoceros (Genda) dekhne jungle safari chalein!
voice_speech: Balle balle! Kaziranga chalte hain! Yahan milta hai shandar ek seeng wala Genda!
kids_facts: Rhino ka seeng haddi nahi, balki hamare naakhun jaise keratin se bana hota hai!
Kaziranga me bache haathi ki peeth par baith kar ghaas me ghoomte hain!
curiosity_question: Genda itna bada hone ke bawjood tez daud sakta hai kya?

name: Ranthambore Tiger Safari
kids_hook: Open Gypsy car me Royal Bengal Tiger ko uske jungle mahal me dekho!
voice_speech: Chalo Ranthambore safari par! Khuli Gypsy me baitho aur tiger ko dhoondo!
kids_facts: Ranthambore me tiger purane qile ke mandiron aur jheel me nahane aate hain!
Har tiger ke sharir ki stripes fingerprint ki tarah bilkul unique hoti hain!
curiosity_question: Tiger paani me swimming kar sakta hai ya nahi?

name: Jim Corbett Jungle Safari
kids_hook: India ka sabse pehla National Park jahan jungle me spotted deer khelte hain!
voice_speech: Dekhiye Jim Corbett jungle! Yahan chital deer, haathi aur peacock jungle me ghoomte hain!
kids_facts: Yeh India ka sabse pehla national park hai jo 1936 me bana tha!
curiosity_question: Hiran jungle me sher ke aane par sabko signal kaise dete hain?

name: Gir Forest Asiatic Lions
kids_hook: Duniya me Africa ke bahar akeli aisi jagah jahan jungle ka Asli Raja Lion rehta hai!
voice_speech: Aao Gir jungle! Yahan rehte hain Asiatic Lions! Unki daadh kitni buland hoti hai!
kids_facts: Asiatic lion ke gale ke baal (mane) African lion se thode chhote hote hain!
curiosity_question: Sher ki dahad kitni door tak sunai deti hai?

name: Arignar Anna Vandalur Zoo
kids_hook: India ka sabse bada zoo jahan colorful butterfly park aur lion safari hai!
voice_speech: Chennai ke Vandalur zoo me colorful titliyan aur lion safari dekhiye!
kids_facts: Yeh 1500 acres me phaila India ka sabse bada zoo park hai!
curiosity_question: Titli phoolon ka ras kaise peeti hai?

name: Nehru Zoological Park
kids_hook: Nocturnal Animal House jahan ullu aur chamgadar din me jaagte hain!
voice_speech: Hyderabad ke Nehru Zoo me toy train ride aur nocturnal animal house ka maza lijiye!
kids_facts: Yahan din me raat ki light banakar nocturnal animals ko dikhaya jata hai!
curiosity_question: Chamgadar andhere me bina takraye kaise udte hain?

name: Sundarbans Floating Forest
kids_hook: Paani me tairte jungle me boat safari aur Royal Bengal Tiger!
voice_speech: Dekho Sundarbans! Yahan ped paani ke andar ugte hain aur boat se jungle ghoomte hain!
kids_facts: Duniya ka sabse bada mangrove forest hai jahan pedon ki jadein hawa me saans leti hain!
curiosity_question: Paani me ped kaise zinda rehte hain?

name: Periyar Elephant Lake Sanctuary
kids_hook: Jheel me boat par baith kar jungle ke haathiyon ko paani peete dekho!
voice_speech: Chalo Kerala ke Periyar! Jheel me boat se wild haathiyo ke jhund ko dekhein!
kids_facts: Haathi apni soond se 8 litre paani ek baar me pee sakte hain!
curiosity_question: Baby haathi apni soond ka use kab seekhta hai?

name: Nehru Planetarium & Space Dome
kids_hook: Giant dome theatre me chhat par taare, chanda mama aur black hole dekhein!
voice_speech: Woohoo! Space rocket me baitho! Nehru Planetarium ke dome me taaron ke beech ghoomein!
kids_facts: Planetarium ke chhat par gol aasmaan banta hai jahan 8 planets ghoomte dikhte hain!
Yahan Rakesh Sharma ji ka asli space suit aur capsule rakha hua hai!
curiosity_question: Space me awaz kyun nahi aati champ?

name: Science City & Dinosaur Park
kids_hook: Hilti-dulti giant T-Rex dinosaur aur Space Odyssey ride!
voice_speech: Science City Kolkata me welcome! Yahan aawaz nikalne wale zinda jaise dinosaur milte hain!
kids_facts: Dinosaur Enclave me robotic dinosaur hilte hain aur roar karte hain!
Time Machine ride me baith kar bache hawa me jhhoolte hain!
curiosity_question: Dinosaur itne hazaron saal pehle kaise gayab ho gaye?

name: Gujarat Science City & Robotics Gallery
kids_hook: Robots se chai pilwayein aur unke sath badminton khelein!
voice_speech: Aao Gujarat Science City! Yahan humanoid robots baat karte hain aur dance karte hain!
kids_facts: Robotics gallery me robot waiter khana serve karta hai!
India ka sabse bada Aquatic Gallery yahan hai jahan shark ke neeche tunnel hai!
curiosity_question: Robot bina dimaag ke kaise kaam karta hai?

name: National Rail Museum
kids_hook: 170 saal purane steam engine aur rajaon ki royal train me chadh kar dekho!
voice_speech: Chalo National Rail Museum! Yahan chalti hai Joy Train aur milte hain asli purane steam engines!
kids_facts: Yahan Fairy Queen rakhi hai jo duniya ka sabse purana working steam engine hai!
Raja Maharajaon ki train me sone-chandi ke bartan hote the!
curiosity_question: Pehle train me koyla kyun daalte the?

name: Visvesvaraya Science Engine Park
kids_hook: Apne haathon se lever ghuma kar bijli banao aur giant pulleys kheecho!
voice_speech: Bengaluru ke science museum me khud scientist baniye! Pulleys ghuma kar car uthao!
kids_facts: Yahan ek full-scale engine model hai jise bache button daba kar chala sakte hain!
curiosity_question: Gears ek dusre ko ghuma kar speed kaise badhate hain?

name: Ramoji Film City
kids_hook: Bahubali ka jadooi mahal, fake airport aur magic stunt show dekhein!
voice_speech: Yaaay! Ramoji Film City me shooting dekho! Yahan banta hai magic movie world!
kids_facts: Duniya ka sabse bada film studio complex hai jo 2000 acres me bana hai!
Yahan Fundustan naam ka special kids amusement zone hai!
curiosity_question: Movie me fake barish aur fake aag kaise banate hain?

name: Jantar Mantar Giant Sun-Dial
kids_hook: Duniya ki sabse badi patthar ki ghadi jo dhoop se bilkul accurate time batati hai!
voice_speech: Jaipur ke Jantar Mantar me dhoop se time dekhne wali jadooi ghadi dekhiye!
kids_facts: Vrihat Samrat Yantra 27 meter uncha hai jo 2 seconds tak accurate time batata hai!
curiosity_question: Suraj ki parchain se time kaise pata chalta hai?

name: Taj Mahal (Agra)
kids_hook: Safed sangmarmar ka jadooi mahal jo subah pink, din me white aur raat ko golden chamakta hai!
voice_speech: Arrey wah! Agra ka Taj Mahal! Dhoop me ye safed chamakta hai aur chandni raat me heere jaisa!
kids_facts: Taj Mahal ko banane me 20,000 workers aur 1000 haathiyon ne 22 saal tak kaam kiya!
Iski 4 minarein thodi si bahar ki taraf jhuki hain taaki earthquake me girne par main dome bach jaye!
curiosity_question: Sangmarmar ka patthar dhoop me garm kyun nahi hota?

name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
kids_hook: Lal balua patthar ka vishal qila jahan se 15 August ko Tiranga phahrata hai!
voice_speech: Dilli ke Lal Qila chalo champ! Yahan se pradhan mantri Tiranga phahrata hain aur tope chalti hai!
kids_facts: Lal Qila ke andar Meena Bazaar aur sound & light laser show hota hai!
curiosity_question: Qile ki deewar itni moti kyun banai gayi thi?

name: India Gate & Kartavya Path
kids_hook: Shaam ko ice-cream khao, fountain dekho aur Amar Jawan Jyoti ko salute karo!
voice_speech: Dekhiye India Gate! Shaam ko yahan fountains chalte hain aur boat ride hoti hai!
kids_facts: India Gate 42 meter uncha hai aur iski deewaron par 13,000 veer sainikon ke naam likhe hain!
curiosity_question: Amar Jawan Jyoti bina bujhe lagatar kaise jalti rehti hai?

name: Hawa Mahal (Wind Palace)
kids_hook: 953 jharokhon wala pink palace jahan bina fan aur AC ke thandi hawa aati hai!
voice_speech: Pink City Jaipur me Hawa Mahal dekho! 953 chhotte jharokhon se thandi hawa aati hai!
kids_facts: Hawa Mahal me aage se koi seedhiyan nahi hain, balki dhalan (ramps) hain!
curiosity_question: Bina pankhe ke mahal ke andar thandi hawa kaise aati hai?

name: Amer Fort & Sheesh Mahal
kids_hook: Haathi ki ride aur kanch ka bana Sheesh Mahal jahan ek mombatti se hazaron sitare chamakte hain!
voice_speech: Chalo Amer Fort! Sheesh Mahal me hazaron kaanch chamak kar taaron jaisa aasmaan banate hain!
kids_facts: Sheesh Mahal Belgium se mangwaye gaye convex mirrors se bana hai!
curiosity_question: Kaanch par roshni padte hi pure room me kaise phail jati hai?

name: Mysore Palace Golden Lights
kids_hook: Ek lakh sunhari lighton se jagmagata asli Raja ka mahal!
voice_speech: Dekhiye Mysore Palace! Sunday shaam ko yahan 1 lakh bulbs ek sath jal kar mahal ko sonaa bana dete hain!
kids_facts: Yahan Dussehra par 750 kilo ka pure gold ka hauda haathi par rakha jata hai!
curiosity_question: 1 lakh bulbs ko chalane ke liye kitni bijli lagti hai?

name: Gateway of India & Mumbai Sea
kids_hook: Samundar ke kinaray vishal dwar jahan se ferry boat me baith kar Elephanta caves jate hain!
voice_speech: Aamchi Mumbai me Gateway of India dekho! Yahan samundar ki lehrein aur flying sea-gulls hain!
kids_facts: Yeh 1911 me King George V ke swagat ke liye banaya gaya tha!
curiosity_question: Samundari chidiya (Sea-gulls) boat ke peeche kyun udti hain?

name: Charminar
kids_hook: Chaar minaron wala qila jahan colorful bangles aur Irani chai milti hai!
voice_speech: Hyderabad ke Charminar dekhiye! 4 unchi minarein aur vibrant Laad Bazaar!
kids_facts: Charminar ke 4 grand arches chaaro dishaon me khulte hain!
curiosity_question: Minar ke andar upar jane ke liye kitni seedhiyan hain?

name: Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib)
kids_hook: Sone se chamakta mandir jahan pavitra sarovar me colorful machhliyan tairti hain!
voice_speech: Sat Sri Akal champ! Amritsar ke Golden Temple me sarovar aur tasty kadha prasad ka anand lo!
kids_facts: Yahan duniya ka sabse bada free kitchen (Langar) hai jahan roz 1 lakh log khana khate hain!
Iski chhat aur deewaron par 500 kilo pure gold ki plating hai!
curiosity_question: Langar me itna saara khana sabke sath milkar kaise banate hain?

name: Wagah Border Parade
kids_hook: Shaandar BSF jawanon ka high-kick march aur 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai' ke naare!
voice_speech: Jai Hind! Wagah Border par Tiranga jhanda utaarne ki high-energy parade dekhiye!
kids_facts: BSF soldiers 6 feet se uncha leg-kick karke march karte hain!
curiosity_question: Sainik border par din-raat pehra kaise dete hain?

name: Statue of Unity (World's Tallest)
kids_hook: Poori duniya ki sabse unchi murti jo America ke Statue of Liberty se bhi 2 times badi hai!
voice_speech: Dekhiye Sardar Patel ji ki Statue of Unity! 182 meter unchi murti ke chest tak lift jati hai!
kids_facts: Yeh itni unchi hai ki 7 kilometer door se bhi saaf dikhai deti hai!
Yahan bache Valley of Flowers aur Jungle Safari park me ghoomte hain!
curiosity_question: Itni badi murti ko tezz toofan se hilne se kaise bachate hain?

name: Qutub Minar & Iron Pillar
kids_hook: India ka sabse uncha eent ka tower aur 1600 saal purana loha jisme kabhi rust nahi lagta!
voice_speech: Dilli ke Qutub Minar dekho champ! 73 meter uncha tower aur jaadui lohe ka khamba!
kids_facts: Iron Pillar 1600 saalon se dhoop-barish me khada hai par usme zang nahi lagta!
curiosity_question: Itni purani eenton ka tower gira kyun nahi?

name: Jaisalmer Golden Sand Fort
kids_hook: Registan me sonaa jaisa chamakta fort aur camel safari!
voice_speech: Thar registan me Sonar Qila dekho! Oont ki safari aur sand dunes par sliding karo!
kids_facts: Yeh duniya ke gine-chune 'Living Forts' me se ek hai jahan log qile ke andar hi rehte hain!
curiosity_question: Registan me ret ke pahad (sand dunes) hawa se kaise chalte hain?

name: Victoria Memorial & Horse Carriage
kids_hook: White marble palace ke samne sundar ghoda-gaadi (Tanga) ride!
voice_speech: Kolkata ke Victoria Memorial me pyari ghoda-gaadi me baith kar ghoomiye!
kids_facts: Iske top dome par ek 16 feet unchi Pari (Angel of Victory) hawa ke sath ghoomti hai!
curiosity_question: Weather cock ki tarah pari hawa ki disha kaise batati hai?

name: Gwalior Fort & Musical Tansen
kids_hook: Pahad ke top par bana qila jiske deewaron par neeli aur peeli ceramic tiles chamakti hain!
voice_speech: Dekho Gwalior ka shandar qila! Yahan colourful haathi aur batakh ki tiles lagi hain!
kids_facts: Is qile ko Babur ne 'Hind ke qilon ka moti' (Pearl of Indian Forts) kaha tha!
curiosity_question: Qile ke andar secret underground baoli (well) kyun banate the?

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
kids_hook: Ek aisa railway station jo kisi raja ke jaadui mahal jaisa dikhta hai!
voice_speech: Mumbai ka CSMT station dekho! Yahan mahal jaisi gumbad me lakho trains chalti hain!
kids_facts: Is station ke pattharon par sher, ghode aur peacocks ki carvers hain!
curiosity_question: Ek station par 18 platforms ek sath kaise manage hote hain?

name: Goa Beach & Dolphin Safari
kids_hook: Samundar me boat par baith kar friendly Dolphins ko koodte hue dekho aur sandcastle banao!
voice_speech: Yaaay Goa beach chalo! Ret me sandcastle banao aur samundar me jump karti Dolphin dekho!
kids_facts: Dolphins bohot smart hoti hain aur seeti (whistle) baja kar baat karti hain!
Goa ke beach par bache shell collection aur sand castle competition karte hain!
curiosity_question: Dolphin machhli hoti hai ya mammal jo hawa me saans leti hai?

name: Andaman Island & Coral Reefs
kids_hook: Glass bottom boat se samundar ke andar colorful corals aur clownfish dekho!
voice_speech: Andaman chalo! Glass bottom boat se samundar ke andar Nemo machhli aur sea turtle dekhiye!
kids_facts: Havelock ka Radhanagar beach Asia ka number one cleanest beach mana gaya hai!
Corals living sea animals hote hain jo colorful pahaad banate hain!
curiosity_question: Glass bottom boat me paani andar kyun nahi aata?

name: Alleppey Kerala Houseboat Cruise
kids_hook: Tairte hue lakdi ke ghar (Houseboat) me baith kar coconut trees ke beech soyein!
voice_speech: Kerala backwaters me Houseboat par chalo! Paani par tairta ghar aur taaza nariyal paani!
kids_facts: Houseboat ko bamboo aur coconut ki rassi se banate hain bina ek bhi keel (nail) thoke!
Boat ke andar bed, kitchen aur balcony sab paani ke upar float karta hai!
curiosity_question: Bina keel ke lakdi ki itni badi boat kaise judti hai?

name: Kanyakumari Triveni Sangam
kids_hook: Jahan 3 bade samundar aapas me milte hain aur ek hi jagah sooraj ugta aur doobta dikhta hai!
voice_speech: Dekhiye India ka southernmost point Kanyakumari! Teen samundaron ka milan aur sunrise!
kids_facts: Yahan Arab Sagar, Bay of Bengal aur Indian Ocean teeno samundar aapas me milte hain!
curiosity_question: Teen samundar ke paani ka rang alag alag kyun dikhta hai?

name: Rameswaram Pamban Sea Bridge
kids_hook: Samundar ke upar chalne wali train aur beech me se khulne wala bridge!
voice_speech: Samundar ke upar train dekho! Pamban bridge bada jahaz aane par beech se do tukdon me khul jata hai!
kids_facts: Yeh 100 saal se zyada purana sea train bridge hai jo cyclone me bhi tike rehta hai!
curiosity_question: Bada ship aane par bridge upar kaise uthta hai?

name: Mumbai Marine Drive & Chowpatty
kids_hook: Samundar ke kinare Queen's Necklace lights aur yummy Chowpatty Kulfi!
voice_speech: Mumbai ki Marine Drive par chaliye! Samundar ki thandi hawa aur chocolate kulfi!
kids_facts: Raat ko street lights ki curve bilkul heeron ke haar (Queen's Necklace) jaisi chamakti hai!
curiosity_question: Marine drive par jo giant 4-legged pathhar (Tetrapods) hain, wo kya karte hain?

name: Konark Sun Temple Giant Chariot
kids_hook: Patthar ka bana vishal rath jisme 24 giant wheels hain jo time batate hain!
voice_speech: Odisha ke Konark chalte hain! Suraj bhagwan ka vishal pahiya rath aur puri beach!
kids_facts: Iske wheels par 8 spokes hain jo din ke 8 pahar (hours) batate hain!
curiosity_question: Pathhar ke pahiye dhoop se time kaise batate hain?

name: Krishna's Butterball & Shore Temple
kids_hook: 250 ton ka vishal patthar jo dhalan par bina phisle 1200 saal se khada hai!
voice_speech: Dekho Krishna's Butterball! 250 ton ka patthar pahaad ki dhalan par ajeeb tarah se tika hai!
kids_facts: 7 haathiyo ne milkar bhi is patthar ko hilane ki koshish ki par ye hila nahi!
curiosity_question: Itna bada gol patthar dhalan par se neeche kyun nahi ludhakta?

name: Jog Falls (Roaring Waterfall)
kids_hook: Pahad se seedha 830 feet neeche girne wala giant roaring jharna!
voice_speech: Wah champ! Jog Falls me 4 jharne - Raja, Roarer, Rocket aur Rani ek sath girte hain!
kids_facts: Monsoon me yahan itni tezz dhuandhaar banti hai ki rainbow har ghante dikhta hai!
curiosity_question: Jharne ke paas rainbow kyun banta hai?

name: Dhuandhar Falls & Marble Rocks
kids_hook: Safed sangmarmar ki ghati me boat ride aur dhuen jaisa jharna!
voice_speech: Jabalpur ke Bhedaghat chalo! Marble rocks ke beech boat ride aur dhuandhar jharna!
kids_facts: Jharna girte waqt paani ki itni baarik boondein udti hain ki lagta hai dhuan nikal raha ho!
curiosity_question: Narmada nadi sangmarmar ke pattharon ko kaise kaat kar nikalti hai?

name: Loktak Lake (Floating Phumdis)
kids_hook: Duniya ka ekmatra Floating National Park jahan zameen paani me tairti hai!
voice_speech: Dekhiye Manipur ka Loktak lake! Yahan zameen paani par tairti hai aur Sangai dancing deer rehta hai!
kids_facts: Yahan tairti hui circular ghaas ke chhatte (Phumdis) hote hain jinke upar log ghar banate hain!
curiosity_question: Ghaas aur mitti paani ke upar tairti kaise rehti hai?

name: Varanasi Ghats & Evening Ganga Aarti
kids_hook: Ganga nadi me boat ride, hazaaron deepak aur giant aarti ke jadooi diyas!
voice_speech: Har Har Mahadev! Kashi ke Dashashwamedh ghat par boat se hazaaron deepakon ki aarti dekhiye!
kids_facts: Varanasi duniya ke sabse purane continuous rehne wale shahron me se ek hai!
curiosity_question: Diye ke neeche patte (donas) paani me deepak ko kaise tairate hain?

name: Hampi Stone Chariot & Musical Pillars
kids_hook: Patthar ke khambe jinhe ungli se bajaane par musical notes Sa-Re-Ga-Ma ki sound aati hai!
voice_speech: Hampi ke jadooi mandir me chaliye! Yahan patthar ke khambe bajakar sangeet bajaya jata hai!
kids_facts: Vittala Temple ke 56 musical pillars ko tap karne par alag-alag sur nikalte hain!
curiosity_question: Solid stone pillar me se music ki ghanti jaisi awaz kaise aati hai?

name: Madurai Meenakshi Temple Tower
kids_hook: 14 vishal towers jinke upar 33,000 colorful statues bani hui hain!
voice_speech: Madurai ke Meenakshi temple me dekho hazaron colorful devi-devtaon aur haathiyo ki statues!
kids_facts: Temple ke gopuram towers par 33,000 se zyada hand-carved colourful sculptures hain!
curiosity_question: Itne unche tower par murtiyan kaise banayi gayi hongi?

name: Ajanta & Ellora Kailash Cave
kids_hook: Ek single giant pahaad ko upar se neeche kaat kar banaya gaya world-wonder mahal!
voice_speech: Ellora ki Kailash cave dekhiye! Poora mahal ek single pahaad ko uupar se tarash kar bana hai!
kids_facts: Isko banane me 2 lakh ton patthar hathode aur chheni se kaat kar nikala gaya tha!
curiosity_question: Bina cement aur jod ke ek hi patthar ka mahal kaise bana?

name: Coorg Elephant Camp & Coffee Mist
kids_hook: Dubare Elephant Camp me haathi ko river me nahlao aur sugarcane khilao!
voice_speech: Chalo Coorg! Yahan Kaveri river me baby haathiyo ko brush se nahlane ka maza milta hai!
kids_facts: Coorg ko 'Scotland of India' kaha jata hai kyunki yahan hamesha dhund aur barish rehti hai!
curiosity_question: Haathi paani me nahana itna kyun pasand karte hain?

name: Chinnar Grizzled Giant Squirrel Sanctuary
kids_hook: Cat ke barabar badi giant colorful gilahri (squirrel) jo pedon par 20 feet lambi chhalang lagati hai!
voice_speech: Munnar ke pass dekho Indian Giant Squirrel! Ye colorful gilahri pedon par super jump karti hai!
kids_facts: Yeh gilahri maroone, purple aur yellow rang ki hoti hai aur iski poonchh 2 feet lambi hoti hai!
curiosity_question: Gilahri itni unchi chhalang lagakar dhaal kaise banati hai?

name: Rishikesh Ram Jhula & River Rafting
kids_hook: Ganga nadi ke upar jhoomne wala suspenson suspension bridge aur monkeys!
voice_speech: Rishikesh me Ram Jhula par chalo! Bridge thoda thoda jhoolta hai aur neeche Ganga nadi behti hai!
kids_facts: Ram Jhula lohe ki moti rassi (cables) se hawa me latka hua hai bina kisi pillar ke!
curiosity_question: Suspension bridge hawa me bina pillar ke kaise tikta hai?

name: Chittorgarh Fort & Vijay Stambh
kids_hook: India ka sabse bada fort jisme 84 paani ke ponds aur 9 manzil uncha Victory Tower hai!
voice_speech: Chittorgarh qila dekhiye! Veer Maharana Pratap ji ki shaurya bhumi aur Vijay Stambh!
kids_facts: Vijay Stambh 9 manzil uncha hai aur iske top se 30 kilometer door tak registan dikhta hai!
curiosity_question: Qile ke andar 84 talab kyun banaye gaye the?

name: Khajuraho Ancient Carved Temples
kids_hook: 1000 saal purane mandir jinme naachte hue musician aur yoddhaon ki statues hain!
voice_speech: Madhya Pradesh ke Khajuraho me balua patthar par bani shandar dancing sculptures dekho!
kids_facts: Mandiron me bina kisi cement ke mortise and tenon joint technique se patthar jode gaye hain!
curiosity_question: Pattharon ko interlocking karke bina cement kaise joda gaya?

name: Rann of Kutch White Salt Desert
kids_hook: Door-door tak baraf jaisa safed namak ka registan jahan full-moon night me jadoo hota hai!
voice_speech: Kutch ka Rann Utsav! Safed namak ka registan, colourful camels aur full moon night!
kids_facts: Yeh duniya ka sabse bada salt desert hai jahan winter me hazaron Flamingos aate hain!
curiosity_question: Zameen ke upar itna sara namak kahan se aata hai?
